calls.statement:
WITH exposed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15
), h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM exposed) exposed_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM exposed)) overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) holdout_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) bak_rows,
 (SELECT holdout_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) bak_holdout,
 (SELECT mailing_list_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) bak_list

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
v AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.join_date FROM dim_member m WHERE DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN v USING(member_id) WHERE v.marketing_consent) consent_ok,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN v USING(member_id) WHERE NOT v.marketing_consent) no_consent,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM v)) no_version_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE marketing_consent) consenting_members_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN v USING(member_id) WHERE v.join_date > DATE '2025-11-24') joined_after,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15 AND delivered) delivered_rows
